what: Seller of digital planners tested Etsy, Gumroad, and Payhip to find consistent sales. Reports each platform works differently depending on seller goals. Describes jumping between all three before settling on this conclusion from direct experience.
verbatim_snippet: "Personally when I first started my business online and selling my digital planners. I jumped from Etsy to Gumroad to Payhip trying to find out which one of the three platforms could help me make consistent sales. After testing all the three, I realized something which is very crucial for every seller must know and that is: Each platform works differently, depending on your goals."
